description: This file defines a mock class AmbxMock for unit testing the AmbxWrapper interface in the prplMesh project. It includes external header dependencies related to the amxc, amxp, amxd, amxb modules, and defines mock methods for various amxb-related functions.

classes.name: AmbxMock
classes.description: A mock class for AmbxWrapper used in unit testing, providing mock implementations of core amxb functions.

methods.name: amxb_be_load
methods.description: Mock method to load the amxb backend from a specified path.

methods.name: amxb_connect
methods.description: Mock method to establish a connection via the amxb bus with a given URI.

methods.name: amxb_register
methods.description: Mock method to register an amxd_dm object with the bus context.

methods.name: amxb_read
methods.description: Mock method to read data from the amxb bus context.

methods.name: amxb_get_fd
methods.description: Mock method to get the file descriptor associated with the amxb bus context.

methods.name: amxb_free
methods.description: Mock method to free the amxb bus context.

methods.name: amxb_be_remove_all
methods.description: Mock method to remove all amxb backend instances.
